title: People & Workforce Learnings: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: No competence standard said who may sign off a pressure-boundary seal change.

items.text: Learnings about systems, not individuals' records.

items.lesson: A seal change on a pressure boundary needs a task authorisation, not only a job title.
items.explanation: The procedure index has no return-to-service entry [EVD-0002], so nothing defined who was competent to sign the job off.

rows: Seal changed and restarted without a leak test
Authorisation for seal changes, including the leak test
Seals bought locally without a specification
Who may approve a substitute part

items.lesson: A pressure-boundary job needs a second person to witness the test.
items.explanation: The work order shows no test and no witness [EVD-0001].

items.text: For training-designer: the leak test before return to service is a training need; this pack sets the standard.

limits: The synthetic export holds nothing on rosters or hours.
